requirements.title: External-unit connection is a symmetric unit-file property
requirements.definition: An external unit is either connected or not connected; if connected, it refers to an external file. Connection is symmetric: the unit is connected to a file if and only if the file is connected to the unit.

requirements.title: C-stream and mixed-language same-file interoperation properties are processor dependent
requirements.definition: For C stream interoperation, whether a Fortran unit can be connected to a file also connected to a C stream is processor dependent; if so, I/O results on that file are processor dependent. Correspondence between INPUT_UNIT, OUTPUT_UNIT, ERROR_UNIT and the predefined C text streams is processor dependent, as are results when Fortran-defined and non-Fortran-defined procedures perform I/O on the same external file.

pending.unit-and-c-stream-shared-connection-proc: No portable oracle may require a Fortran unit to connect, or fail to connect, to a file already connected to a C stream.
pending.shared-c-stream-io-results-processor-dep: No portable oracle may assert ordering, buffering, or contents after both Fortran I/O and C stream I/O target the same external file.
pending.iso-units-c-predefined-stream-correspond: No portable oracle may equate INPUT_UNIT, OUTPUT_UNIT, or ERROR_UNIT with stdin, stdout, or stderr beyond the Fortran preconnection properties.
pending.mixed-language-same-file-io-results-proc: No portable oracle may assert results when Fortran and non-Fortran procedures perform I/O on the same external file; future mixed-language tests keep files distinct.

requirements.definition: After CLOSE disconnects an external unit, it may be connected again within the same program to the same or a different file. After CLOSE disconnects an external file, it may be connected again within the same program to the same or a different unit.
